## 9f74cf8633e5

**Finding A1 — plausible overlap-exclusion shortcut; measured teaching-domain restriction, not a validator-accepted defect.** Audited generator SHA-256 `d50ff9c7b7256733a8126a3f541d0a0ae1543b42f9eb54a60c654381629b14b0`; executed rule hash `3de95ecac741`.

The intended local rule fills a blank center when its four diagonal neighbors have the same nonzero color. The current generator and `self_check` require recognized 3×3 motif footprints to be disjoint. A plausible rival therefore adds one condition: fill a valid center only when its 3×3 footprint is disjoint from every other valid center.

That rival fit all 3/3 canonical labeled pairs and all 300 ordinary generated samples checked (seed recipe in the retained probe; 100 samples per easy/medium/hard band). It disagrees on the retained 7×7 input containing two valid color-4 centers at `(2,2)` and `(2,4)` whose 3×3 footprints overlap. The canonical Racket authority fills both centers; the rival fills neither. The target validator rejects the witness with `recognized motif footprints overlap`, so I classify this as a distribution/teaching question rather than a malformed-label or validator-acceptance bug. The finite 300-sample fit is not a proof over every draw.

Evidence:
- `checks/audit/9f74cf8633e5/overlap_shortcut_result.json`
- `checks/audit/9f74cf8633e5/overlap_shortcut_probe.py`
- `checks/audit/9f74cf8633e5/racket_authority.json`

No fix was applied; this target was audit-only.
